_comment: Model pins merged into ~/.claude/settings.json by scripts/install-user-config.* (only keys you have not set yourself). The aliases opus / sonnet / haiku in agent files, /model and opusplan follow the newest model of each family; these env keys pin what each alias means, so a new release changes nothing until you bump a pin on purpose, after checking its price. Current pins (price per million input/output tokens): Opus 5.5 $4/$20, Sonnet 5 $2/$10, Haiku 4.5 $1/$5. Fable 5.1 ($10/$50) is never pinned for subagents. To bump: change the ID here, re-run the installer (it never overwrites a pin you changed by hand, so edit ~/.claude/settings.json too if you had).
